description: We're an established duo with a strong interest in problem solving, design, and discovering how things work in our world. Anyone willing to help our concept for our project come to life is welcome to join.
summary: "Aura-MED" is a concept health monitoring app designed to help Astronauts manage the side effects of space flight, in a seamless way, when communication delays prevent real-rime help from Earth, that can be hard for one to manage on their own. It  pulls data from existing space hardware: the Oxford Nanopore MinION sequencer, Microfluidic Diagnostic Strips, Mirion radiation dosimeters, and ARCHeR sleep monitors, into one simple dashboard. Instead of leaving non-doctor astronauts with confusing lab charts from tools like EPI2ME, our system translates everything into plain-English alerts and step-by-step medical checklists. It also includes an offline Edge-AI (local) protocol assistant so crew members can ask urgent medical questions without needing an internet connection to Earth.
